title: Multi-residue pesticides analysis in water samples using reverse phase high performance liquid chromatography (RP-HPLC)
author: Rajput, Kumari, et al.

steps.title: Liquid‑liquid extraction of water
steps.instruction: Extract pesticides from 2 L of water using n‑hexane in a separating funnel.

substeps.instruction: Place 2 L water sample in a separating funnel.
Add 100 mL n‑hexane and shake several times.
Repeat the addition of 100 mL n‑hexane and shaking two more times (total three extractions).
Collect and combine all organic layers.

steps.title: Dry organic extract
steps.instruction: Remove residual water from the combined organic layers.

substeps.instruction: Pass the combined organic layers through anhydrous sodium sulphate.

steps.title: Concentrate extract
steps.instruction: Reduce the dried organic fraction to a small volume.

substeps.instruction: Evaporate the dried extract on a rotary evaporator until the volume reaches 1 mL.

steps.title: Reconstitute and filter sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the final extract for HPLC analysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL acetonitrile to the 1 mL concentrate.
Filter the mixture through a 0.22 μm syringe filter.

steps.title: Prepare pesticide stock solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve each pesticide in acetonitrile to obtain a 500 mg L⁻¹ stock solution.

steps.title: Prepare working solutions
steps.instruction: Serially dilute the 500 mg L⁻¹ stock solutions with acetonitrile to the concentrations required for analysis.
